what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Peru, as counted by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 82287 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence; UNHCR reports no internally displaced people for Peru in that year.
Refugees from Peru live mostly in the United States, Canada, Spain and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Peru with Sendero Luminoso from 2007 to 2010.
Earthquakes, erosion, floods, mass movements, storms and wildfires are among the disasters recorded for Peru in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures fell from 150000 in 2009 to the 2025 figure.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2014 and 2024 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC also counts new displacements from disasters in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
